title: Person (proposed demo demand)
identifier_representations: INTEGER; PersonID: optional customer person local FK; namespace adventureworks:Sales.Customer
practical_value: Proposed field-role demand in 1 demos. Candidate reference/calendar/identifier lookup with contextual bridge and measured match rate; local transaction/person IDs support internal joins only.
licence_notes: Candidate metadata is unreconciled. Per-input data/model/meaning licences remain in demand-plan.json and recordset records; Employees-derived evidence retains CC-BY-SA-3.0. No blanket CC0 or canonical new meaning licence is asserted.
reason:
Related concepts, entity keys/names/attributes and physical roles remain separately qualified in assertions. Coverage means inspected hypothesis presence, not accepted semantic equivalence or external match rate.

Phase 2 ACCEPTED: Accepted reuse of core person; this is concept/role reuse, not raw-value or cross-dataset identity equivalence. Source-local person, customer, employee, supplier, store and business-entity IDs have no cross-demo or real-world identity. Customer/supplier/employer/operator are roles; organisation, legal entity, site and registration differ. A native PK/FK supports only its declared source relationship. Alternate unique names/GUIDs are source-scoped; names are not LEI/ROR/ORCID or a portable person key.
